parts:
Check case: mytable vs. myTable
On Thu, Jan 28, 2016 at 2:42 PM Lawrence Lin <eque...@gmail.com> wrote:
I installed a package called Agreement(), which takes input information from control widgets and output 3 rows of statistics to be printed.  The script in Server.R are listed below, but got an error of "object 'myTable' not found".  I don't know what shall I do to print these three rows as a html table.  Please advise.  Thanks!

library("Agreement")
 shinyServer(function(input, output) {

    output$table1 <- renderTable({ 
      agr=agreement(y=y, x=x, V_label=input$V_label, H_label=input$H_label,
               min=as.numeric(input$min), max=as.numeric(input$max),
               by=as.numeric(input$by), CCC_a=as.numeric(input$CCC_a),
               CP_a=as.numeric(input$CP_a), TDI_a=as.numeric(input$TDI_a),
               error=input$error, target=input$target, 
               dec=as.numeric(input$dec), alpha=as.numeric(input$alpha))

      object <- agr$Estimate
      mytable <- cbind(round(object$CCC, 4), round(object$Precision,4), 
                       round(object$Accuracy, 4), 
                       round(object$TDI, as.numeric(input$dec)),
                       round(object$CP, 4), round(object$RBS, 2))
      colnames(mytable) <- c("CCC", "Precision", "Accuracy", "TDI","CP",
                             "RBS")
      rownames(mytable) <- ""
      print(myTable)
      })
})
